title: Wipe a monitor lead, cord and both end pieces, outward from its blue band, never wiping back
instruction: Wipe the whole grey monitor lead with the wipe pads, the cord from end to end and every face of both end pieces, undersides included, wiping outward from the blue band and never back over any part already wiped, then lay the lead on the white drape and let go.
context: O*NET: Medical Assistants (833,900 US workers) "Clean and sterilize instruments" (importance 94), "Clean medical equipment", "Operate ... electrocardiogram (EKG) ... equipment"; LPNs (666,900) "Sterilize equipment and supplies, using germicides". Philips ECG guide: "Wipe the entire outer surfaces of the cable". Damp-wiping guide: "wiping each part of the surface ONCE is enough." Ability: one-way wipe along a free cord and over every face of both end pieces, hands switching roles.
setup: Cm from the midpoint between the arm bases on the table (x forward, y to robot's left). Arm bases at x 0, y +30.5 (left) and y -30.5 (right); both arms start in their ready pose, gripper about 26 cm above the table at x 32 in front of its base. Lead: grey 6 mm round PVC cord, 60 cm, straight along y at x 40 from y 6.25 to y -53.75; grey plug 35x16x12 mm (12 g) on its left end (centre y 8), red patient clip 25x15x15 mm (10 g) on its right end. Blue tape band 2 cm wide on the cord 14-16 cm from the plug end (y -7.75 to -9.75). Drape: white cloth on a 3 mm board, 18x76 cm, x 12-30, y -56 to 20, taped down. Wipes: PDI Sani-Cloth Plus pre-moistened disinfectant wipes, 6 x 6.75 in (about 15x17 cm); one per gripper, cut in half, each half folded to an 8-layer pad about 4x4 cm and 3 mm thick, backed with 3 mm EVA craft foam (pad ~6 mm), laid over one finger's gripping face, wrapped round its tip and 2.5 cm up its outer face, standing out ~1 cm past each side edge, held by a rubber band over a nitrile finger cot that keeps the moist wipe and tracer off the gripper (cots and pads discarded after each trial), fitted before the trial; the robot grips everything through them. With the pads fitted, note the gripper gap g0 when closed on nothing; real-trial gap thresholds are the scoring ones plus g0. Before the trial dust with UV tracer powder the whole cord and every face of the plug and clip (long sides, top, underside, tip face, cord face all round the cord; lift each piece to dust its underside), mark the cord every 1 cm from 0.5 to 59.5 cm and draw a line round the plug and the clip 8 mm from the cord face.
scoring: Score 0 if (latched): a hand closed on the cord (gap <= 7 mm; real trial 7 mm + g0, g0 = gap closed on nothing with pads) goes over 3 cm back along its stroke or comes over 3 cm closer to the end piece behind it; a stroke passes over more than 4 already-wiped 1 cm marks; a pass on an end piece's sides, top or underside goes over 1 cm back toward the cord or re-wipes a part already wiped; or at the end the plug is not on the drape or a gripper is within 3 cm of the lead. Strokes wipe the 1 cm marks (60, end to end) their pads slide over while the other hand holds the end piece behind; toward the clip from 13.5 cm, toward the plug up to 16.5 cm. Each end piece has eight parts, all wiped with the other hand holding the far end: the stroke brings the pads to its cord face (pad centre within 13 mm along the table) and opens there (pad edges sweep the face); one side pass, pads at its width, from straddling the cord face off past the tip; one closed-finger pass turned along it, down the cord face above the cord, over the whole top (fingertip 0-6 mm above, sim) and down the tip face; and, with the piece turned a quarter turn so its underside faces sideways, one shut-finger pass whose outer face sweeps the strip of cord face under the cord out past the underside's edge and then slides along the whole underside. Real trial: tracer gone from each mark and face, and the motion on video. c = fraction of marks wiped. 0.3: c 0.5 to <0.9. 0.6: c >= 0.9 but a mark or part missed or the lead not all on the drape. 1.0: every mark, all 16 parts, whole lead on the drape.
reset_notes: Lay the lead straight along the tape line at x 40 cm, plug centre on its mark at y 8 cm, clip end to the right; drape flat and empty on its tape marks. Fit fresh nitrile finger cots and fresh wipe pads to both grippers. Real trial: dust the whole cord and every face of the plug and clip, undersides included, with UV tracer powder and mark the cord every 1 cm from 0.5 to 59.5 cm; afterwards a mark or face counts as wiped when it is clean under a UV torch.
fidelity: Lead: 2 cm rigid segments, soft bending springs, no twist; plug and clip rigid boxes. Wipe pads not modelled: cord marks count when they pass between bare finger pads closed on the cord; end-piece passes credit the bare fingers 0-6 mm from each face, inside the 6 mm foam-backed pad's thickness, so the real pad touches or presses. Real trial reads wiping from UV tracer on the cord and every face of both end pieces. Drape is a fixed board.
